scope: Source review; complete suite running separately. Native GPU admission pending.
review: Actual prior MCP environment omitted device selection and bound GPU0 while bridge/GGX bound GPU1.
Launch MCP config and setup_agents explicitly copy only four present device variables verbatim; no defaults or device probing.
Absent, empty, ordinal-list, UUID, MIG, CUDA_DEVICE_ORDER, CPU and require-CUDA preserved; explicit extra env overrides inherited.
Regression executes real registration heredoc then isolated stdlib child with explicit environment only; no GPU context/robot RPC.
Quickstart describes registration and limits; native acceptance not yet claimed.
